description: Curated open-access PMC articles with explicit dengue treatment and NSAID contraindication language. All IDs verified against the NCBI BioC JSON API.

pmc_ids.title: Treatment of dengue fever
pmc_ids.rationale: Recommends paracetamol; other NSAIDs should be avoided during the febrile phase.

pmc_ids.title: DENGUE VIRAL INFECTIONS
pmc_ids.rationale: Explicit: aspirin and ibuprofen should be avoided; use paracetamol.

pmc_ids.title: Dengue fever: a Wikipedia clinical review
pmc_ids.rationale: States ibuprofen and aspirin should be avoided due to bleeding risk.

pmc_ids.title: Viral Immune Evasion in Dengue: Toward Evidence-Based Revisions of Clinical Practice Guidelines
pmc_ids.rationale: NSAIDs contraindicated due to anticoagulant properties in DHF/DSS.

pmc_ids.title: Dengue: Moving from Current Standard of Care to State-of-the-Art Treatment
pmc_ids.rationale: WHO-aligned antipyresis; NSAIDs contraindicated with thrombocytopenia.

pmc_ids.title: Dengue infection: current concepts and challenges (review)
pmc_ids.rationale: Broad dengue management review with analgesic precautions.

pmc_ids.title: Dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever: a review of the literature
pmc_ids.rationale: Classic clinical management summary including NSAID avoidance.
